text: Got it, written as TCL50 (permanent rule + build). Plan: a free GitHub workflow checks hourly whether you've said anything (a chat message, terminal message or inbox entry; the app merely syncing doesn't count). After 3 quiet days it sends you a 'still there?' notification + chat message. 24 h with no reply: it turns the engine off, disables every workflow, and writes a STOP flag that every Claude session and routine on all 3 accounts obeys (they exit at once). Your next message in any account clears it and I'll tell you what was switched off. Starting now.
